parameters.query:
SELECT j.id AS job_id, j.category, j.buyer_id, j.seller_id, j.agreed_price, j.accepted_bid_id,
  (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM (
     SELECT id, price, proposed_milestones, seller_id FROM bids
      WHERE id = coalesce($2::uuid, j.accepted_bid_id)) x) AS bid,
  (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM (
     SELECT idx, amount, status::text AS status FROM milestones
      WHERE job_id = j.id AND idx = $3::int) x) AS milestone,
  (SELECT row_to_json(x) FROM (
     SELECT d.commit_sha, d.attempt FROM deliveries d
       JOIN milestones m ON m.id = d.milestone_id
      WHERE m.job_id = j.id AND m.idx = $3::int
      ORDER BY d.attempt DESC LIMIT 1) x) AS delivery,
  (SELECT a.spec_hash FROM acceptance_specs a
    WHERE a.job_id = j.id AND a.locked_at IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY a.version DESC LIMIT 1) AS spec_hash,
  (SELECT s.near_account_id FROM sellers s
    WHERE s.id = coalesce(j.seller_id,
          (SELECT seller_id FROM bids WHERE id = coalesce($2::uuid, j.accepted_bid_id)))) AS seller_account
FROM jobs j
WHERE j.id = $1::uuid;
